question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Fantastically
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Fabulously**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Fantastically"** means in a way that is extremely good or excellent. (अद्भुत रूप से)

 
 
• **Example: **She performed fantastically in her dance recital.
 
 
 
• **"Fabulously"** means in an extremely good or impressive manner. (शानदार रूप से)
 
 
• **Example: **He was fabulously wealthy and owned several mansions around the world.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that "Fantastically" and "Fabulously" are synonymous.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Fabulously**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Scantily** (अल्प मात्रा में): In a way that is small or insufficient in quantity.

 
 
• **Example:** The room was scantily furnished with just a bed and a chair.
 
 
 
• **Scarcely** (मुश्किल से): Only just; almost not.
 
 
• **Example:** She could scarcely believe her eyes when she saw the surprise party.
 
 
 
• **Nominally** (नाममात्र): In name only; officially though perhaps not in reality.
 
 
• **Example:** He is only nominally in charge of the project.
